name: Amatitlán II
summary: Outflow-zone extension of the producing Amatitlán field, centered on the Los Humitos crater northeast of the existing plant — a 175–200°C outflow plume fed by the deeper ~285°C Amatitlán reservoir, accessible at 250–650m depth within the crater, with a deeper ~190°C target further out. Outflow is structurally controlled by LiDAR-mapped N/NW-striking normal faults and crater-ring fractures. Current work focuses on confirming injectivity and refining the structural model with MT geophysics.
